messages:
sasha: Hey team — quick review request. Pushed a prototype where the p95 annotation line has an inline telemetry CTA in the heatmap legend (see figma link). Want thoughts on copy + placement before I hand off to devs. https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/latency-heatmap vikram: Link looks good. Curious about the telemetry CTA — is that going to toggle sending sample prompts back to us or just event-level metrics? leah: The intent was event-level only (counts, sample rates, anonymized shapes). Not customer payloads. We should make that explicit in the copy. sasha: Right — current copy I mocked: "Share anonymized latency samples to improve insights". Thinking it might be too long in the legend. kevin: Agree it's long. Also worried about contrast when we add CTA text inside the compact legend — runs into a11y contrast drop when stacked on heatmap bg. aisha: Could we move to an icon + short label? e.g., 🔍 "Share samples" with a tooltip that expands copy and privacy details on hover/keyboard focus. sasha: I like icon + short label. Tooltip would contain: "Sends anonymized timing samples (no PII). Used to surface patterns and improve forecasts." Should we add a learn-more link there? vikram: Add a learn-more link to the tooltip that opens our privacy page. For the tooltip itself, we need keyboard focus behavior. Figma shows hover-only now. figma-bot: Updated prototype: tooltip now appears on focus + hover and has a 1s open delay to avoid accidental triggers. kevin: Nice. A11y nit: tooltip must be reachable via Tab and have role="tooltip" + aria-describedby referencing the trigger for screen readers. Also watch for focus trap inside tooltip if we add links. sasha: Good call. Draft aria suggestion I dropped in the figma notes: ```
Sends anonymized timing samples. Learn more
``` leah: Copy nit: instead of "anonymized timing samples" maybe "anonymized latency samples" — clearer for customers used to p95/p99 language. aisha: Also, for non-technical viewers, 'samples' might be confusing. Maybe "share latency data (anonymized)"? Short label: "Share latency" vikram: Implementation note: sampling frequency varies by preset. We should show current sample rate in tooltip, e.g., "Sampling 1 in 100" so customers understand volume/cost implications. kevin: UI spacing nit: legend is tight on mobile. If we add icon + label it could wrap weirdly. Consider collapsing to icon-only at <=420px and expose label in the tooltip. sasha: Good responsive suggestion. I'll add a breakpoint rule: legend shows icon+label on >=420px, icon-only on smaller widths. Tooltip always available. leah: One more copy test: CTA button in heatmap legend — should it be a neutral link or a toggle? We're changing a setting, so toggle makes sense. aisha: Toggle is clearer semantically. Use aria-pressed for the button state. vikram: If it's a toggle that persists per-org, we need product to confirm server-side flag + analytics event names. I can do that with backend once copy+placement are final. sasha: Sounds like next steps: final copy = short label "Share latency"; tooltip expanded copy uses "Sends anonymized latency samples (no PII). Sampling visible in tooltip." Devs + eng to confirm aria pattern and storage; design to add responsive rules. Any other concerns? kevin: Logging: make sure the tooltip's learn-more link opens in a new tab to avoid losing context when debugging incidents. leah: +1 on new tab. Also add a small privacy icon inside tooltip next to copy. sasha: Great — I'll update Figma and create a dev ticket with aria snippet, breakpoint rule, and analytics acceptance criteria. Thanks all :heart: vikram: Thanks — assigning to eng-ml for sampling config when ticket lands. figma-bot: Comment added to frame "Legend — telemetry CTA" with updated specs.
